subject: math
name: Mathematics
title: Grade 11 Mathematics: Algebra II
overview: Grade 11 Mathematics delivers advanced mathematical preparation, rigorous logical deduction, and complex modeling across algebraic, geometric, trigonometric, and analytical domains.
competencies: Construct formal deductive arguments, proofs, and mathematical models to solve real-world problems.
Analyze functions, coordinate systems, and algebraic structures with computational accuracy.
Apply advanced formulas, theorems, and mathematical transformations.
Communicate mathematical reasoning fluently using precise symbolic notation and graphical representations.

modules.title: Polynomial, Rational, and Radical Relationships
modules.description: Extending polynomial operations, polynomial division, factoring higher-degree polynomials, the complex number system, and solving rational equations.

topics.title: Complex Numbers and the Fundamental Theorem of Algebra
topics.description: Defining the imaginary unit i, performing operations with complex numbers, and proving polynomial root behaviors.

topics.title: Polynomial Long Division and Remainder Theorem
topics.description: Executing polynomial long division and synthetic division, evaluating zeros of higher-degree polynomials.

topics.title: Rational and Radical Equations
topics.description: Solving rational equations, identifying extraneous solutions, and graphing rational functions with asymptotes.

modules.title: Trigonometric Functions and the Unit Circle
modules.description: Extending trigonometry to all real numbers using the unit circle, radian measure, graphing sine and cosine, and trigonometric identities.

topics.title: The Unit Circle and Radian Measure
topics.description: Defining trigonometric values for angles in all four quadrants on the unit circle.

topics.title: Graphing Periodic Functions (Sine and Cosine)
topics.description: Analyzing amplitude, period, midline, phase shifts, and modeling periodic real-world phenomena (sound waves, tides).

modules.title: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
modules.description: Defining logarithms as inverses of exponential functions, logarithmic properties, natural base e, and solving exponential equations.

topics.title: Logarithmic Foundations and Properties
topics.description: Translating between exponential and logarithmic form, applying product, quotient, and power rules of logarithms.

topics.title: Exponential Modeling and Compound Interest
topics.description: Modeling continuous exponential growth and decay using y = ae^(rt) and calculating half-life and compound interest.

modules.title: Inferences and Conclusions from Data
modules.description: Evaluating random sampling, normal probability distributions, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing in statistical studies.

topics.title: Normal Distributions and the Empirical Rule
topics.description: Applying the 68-95-99.7 rule and z-score calculations to estimate population percentages.

topics.title: Sample Surveys, Experiments, and Observational Studies
topics.description: Distinguishing between correlation and causation and evaluating margin of error in sample statistics.
